name: swarm-architectures
description: Use when the user asks about an agent swarm, multi-agent debate, judge agent, mixture of agents, actor-model agents or router-to-specialist prototypes. Produces an R&D swarm design with bounded rounds and equal-budget baselines to prove it beats one model. Not for production multi-agent runtimes (use ai-multi-agent-systems) or picking a product topology (use multi-agent-topology).
